cases.name: Parquet null profiling before training
cases.input: Profile features.parquet and identify columns with high null rates before training.
expected_behaviors: Calls profile_dataset tool before writing any custom pandas code
Reports null_pct per column and flags columns above 20%
Notes the shape (rows, cols) of the dataset
should_not: Write raw pandas code to compute nulls before calling profile_dataset
Treat high cardinality as an error without explaining the implication

cases.name: Leakage audit on temporal cutoff column
cases.input: Check whether any features might be leaking future information through the offset_date cutoff column.
expected_behaviors: Explains that offset_date is a per-row cutoff, not a global split
Warns that all feature lookbacks must filter on < offset_date for the specific row
Flags any features that are only available after the cutoff date (inference-time unavailable features)
Distinguishes features available at training time from those only available at inference time
should_not: Treat offset_date as a global train/test split date
Use inference-only features in the training feature set

cases.name: Binary target distribution check
cases.input: The model's positive rate looks very low. Check the target distribution and tell me if it's expected.
expected_behaviors: Runs profile_dataset with the target column specified
Asks the user to confirm the expected positive rate range for their use-case
Flags if the rate is unusually low and suggests checking date filters and data pipeline
should_not: Recommend oversampling or SMOTE without first confirming the actual rate
Assume a fixed expected positive rate without referencing the user's use-case baseline
